question: Which of the following periods is known as the period of population explosion in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951 - 1981.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The period of **population explosion** in India is from **1951-1981.** 
 
• During this time, India's population grew at an** unprecedented rate** of **2.2% per year.**
 
• The population explosion was due to a combination of factors such as** improvements in healthcare, increased food production, and a decrease in infant mortality rates.**
 
• This period also saw the implementation of **family planning programs** in India to control population growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1931-1961** saw a **moderate population growth rate **in India due to a decrease in mortality rates and improvements in healthcare.
 
• **1921-1951** saw a **decrease in India's population growth **rate due to famines and epidemics.
 
• Increases in a population's or a dispersed group's size are known as** population growth.**
 
• The actual annual increase in the human population is about** 83 million, or 1.1%**.
